_comment: Remote desktop, user-installed: the vendor's terms do not allow redistribution or automated downloads, so the hub never fetches it — it only detects what the person put there and manages it. PowerShell's Test-Path prints False but exits 0, so the Windows check turns the result into the exit status.
name: anydesk
title: AnyDesk
description: Remote desktop, reachable by AnyDesk address
